goal: Catch BSD-specific regressions in per-PR CI before they reach master
Replace FreeBSD cross-compilation with native build and test runs in a VM
agreement: Substantive support for running tests in Core CI rather than relying on nightlies (fanquake, pinheadmz)
Concept approval to test on at least one BSD target (hebasto, vasild)
Concerns about nested VM brittleness and false alarms resolved by agreeing to trial it (maflcko)
Suggested stress-testing nested VMs with 100-200 tasks to check for crashes (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it adds per-PR native CI testing on FreeBSD to catch platform regressions
Prevents reactive fixes after regressions slip into master undetected

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it runs existing functional tests in a native BSD environment with minor script fixes
